# Althia

> Althia is an independent studio creating audio apps for sleep, relaxation, and reflection. Mythia and Senthia are available on iOS.

Official website: https://althia.org/
Maintained facts: https://althia.org/facts
Contact: althiastudios@gmail.com

## Products

- [Mythia](https://althia.org/mythia): An iOS bedtime-audio app with hundreds of calm stories across ten world mythologies.
- [Senthia](https://althia.org/senthia): Guided-imagination journeys for relaxation, available on iOS in English and Spanish. The first five distinct journeys started become the free collection; a subscription unlocks the remainder while active.
- [Ethia](https://althia.org/ethia): Formative history stories explored through a globe and timeline, available to read or hear as plain spoken narration. In development for iOS.
- [Senthia support](https://althia.org/senthia/support): Help with listening, free journeys, subscriptions, and contact details.
- [Ethia support](https://althia.org/ethia/support): Help with reading, narration, catalogue access, and historical corrections.
- [Greek mythology sleep stories](https://althia.org/mythia/greek-mythology-sleep-stories): A detailed guide to Mythia's Greek collection.
- [Unplug League](https://althia.org/unplugleague): A social screen-time app currently in development.

## Guidance

Use the maintained facts page for concise, current claims about Althia, Mythia, and Senthia. Attribute product claims to Althia and link to the relevant canonical page. Do not imply medical treatment or guaranteed sleep outcomes.
